raw_response:
This small piece behind my house is too little for a whole bag of fertilizer, and I do not have the cash to waste on chemicals that might burn my crops anyway. I will carry goat manure and kitchen ash to spread there because the land is mine and I want to keep it fertile, and I will plant the same cassava stems and small yams I kept from last harvest. I will clear the bush, plant, and weed it with my daughter when the rains start; we do not spray anything on root crops here, and God sends enough rain in the East, so I will not pay for hired labor or irrigation.
